product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace-experience platform for organizations that brings employee communications and office-space services—including an intranet, employee app, digital signage, room booking, and visitor management—together.
product_one_liner.notes: Appspace describes a single platform connecting workplace communications and office spaces, and lists intranet, employee mobile app, digital signage, room booking, and visitor management as components.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public page titled Appspace Pricing Plans at the /pricing URL, and its navigation links to Pricing; this meets the public pricing-page criterion.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Appspace case-studies page displays Costco Wholesale, and an Appspace case study identifies Insight Enterprises as a customer. | named_customers.0: The Appspace case-studies page displays Costco Wholesale as a customer. | named_customers.1: The Appspace case study names Insight Enterprises and describes its use of Appspace.

employee_band.notes: Appspace’s LinkedIn company profile gives its size as 201–500 employees, matching the specified band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Appspace report names Tampa as the headquarters city. | hq_country: The company report identifies the headquarters as Tampa, Florida, which places it in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Appspace Type 2 SOC 3 report directly states that Appspace was founded in 2002.

eng_blog.notes: The readable official blog index shows nine posts about workplace trends, customer-facing product capabilities, and marketing/industry topics; it does not show two posts by engineers explaining how the product is built. Although Appspace has a technology category, the index does not establish a qualifying engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Appspace links to a public Knowledge Center, and its docs include multiple knowledge categories and articles, including security requirements and cloud-architecture/release-schedule material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Greenhouse board lists seven openings: two security roles, one business development representative, and four account-executive roles. None of the listed job titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: Azure AI and Google Vertex AI
model_provider.notes: Appspace’s security whitepaper explicitly says its LLM models use Azure AI and Google Vertex AI.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Appspace’s AI/security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR among its trust credentials; these are the three requested items named on that page. | compliance_certs.0: The company page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The company page explicitly names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The company page explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Caplight identifies Appspace’s last funding round as Growth Equity, dated September 21, 2023. | funding_date: The Appspace funding profile lists the latest round as September 21, 2023, which formats to 2023-09.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent round identified by the funding profile was Growth Equity on September 21, 2023, and the dated investor announcement confirms that round. It predates the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers listing includes a Business Development Representative and multiple Account Executive openings; the company’s job board also showed a BDR opening before the queried date.

launched_6mo.notes: Appspace’s July 10, 2026 announcement is titled “Dorado: new features to power your workplace experience.” The dated feature announcement falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Appspace announced on March 19, 2026 that Eric Daggett joined as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward as Chief Technology Officer; both appointments fall within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Appspace’s BDR posting names Salesforce, SalesLoft, and Chili Piper as platforms the team uses; it also calls for proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn. The combined named stack is reported without the duplicate Salesforce entry. | crm_stack_signal.0: The BDR job posting names Salesforce as a platform used by the team. | crm_stack_signal.1: The BDR job posting names SalesLoft. | crm_stack_signal.2: The BDR job posting names Chili Piper. | crm_stack_signal.3: The BDR job posting names Gong among the sales tools for which proficiency is expected. | crm_stack_signal.4: The BDR job posting names ZoomInfo. | crm_stack_signal.5: The BDR job posting names LinkedIn.
